outline.description: This chapter establishes the context of the case, detailing the specific events surrounding the police response to the domestic violence call, the interaction between the officer and the homeowner, the subsequent search, and the procedural path of the case through the district court and to the Seventh Circuit.

outline.description: This chapter outlines the Fourth Amendment legal framework applicable to the case, focusing specifically on the consent exception to the warrant requirement, the authority of third parties to consent, and the standards used to evaluate voluntariness and scope.
